periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation, approximately 45-60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering downward toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval/teardrop shape where the vertical-diagonal length is significantly greater than the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, with the lower extremity extending significantly further from the center than the upper boundary.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape curve at the posterior edge where the black dorsal band meets the white fur of the lower back.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, covering approximately one-third of the visible torso length from the shoulder line downward.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap between ears, estimated at roughly 1.5 to 2 times the width of an individual pinna.

other_distinctive_markers: A single, vertical green bamboo stalk is held in the right forelimb, bisecting the visual field of the panda's torso.
